# outputs/mhw/figures/

Core MHW overview figures (regional SST; count / duration / intensity vs year).

## Typical files

`{region}_bob_sst.png`, `{region}_count_vs_year.png`, `{region}_duration_vs_year.png`, `{region}_intensity_vs_year.png`, `all_regions_sst.png`, `regional_sst_2016_2025.png`.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/plot_regional_sst.py` and related MHW plotting / report scripts.

## Upstream / Downstream

Timeseries + catalogue statistics → figures → presentations / root README illustration.
